w_alt: This description is read aloud to people who cannot see, and it shows if the image does not load. One short sentence is enough.
w_title_empty: Without a title, the page is hard to spot in the site, in search engines and in browser tabs.
g_summary_one: {count} page has no description for search engines{where}.
g_summary_other: {count} pages have no description for search engines{where}.
w_summary: It is the small text shown under the title in Google. One or two sentences are enough, in the page's "Summary" field.
g_title_dup_one: {count} page has the same title as another{where}.
g_title_dup_other: {count} pages have the same title as another{where}.
w_title_dup: Two pages with the same title get mixed up in search results and in the menu: one word of difference is enough.
g_translation_one: {count} page does not seem to be translated into {lang}.
g_translation_other: {count} pages do not seem to be translated into {lang}.
w_translation: Visitors reading in {lang} see the original text. If that is on purpose (a proper name, for example), you can ignore the remark.
g_internal_one: {count} link leads to a page of this site that no longer exists{where}.
g_internal_other: {count} links lead to pages of this site that no longer exist{where}.
w_internal: The page may have been deleted, renamed or put back to draft: your visitors would see an error page.
g_home: The home page has no description for search engines.
w_home: Add a tagline in the site settings: it is what shows under your site's name in Google.
w_contact: Your visitors and partners do not know how to write to you. You can add it in the site settings.
g_empty: Your site does not contain any published page or article yet.
w_empty: Nothing wrong if you are just starting: create your first page whenever you like.
g_link_gone_one: {count} link leads to a page that no longer exists.
g_link_gone_other: {count} links lead to pages that no longer exist.
w_link_gone: The website answers, but says the page cannot be found. Fix the address or remove the link.
g_img_gone_one: {count} image from another website no longer shows.
g_img_gone_other: {count} images from other websites no longer show.
w_img_gone: The image was removed or moved over there. Upload it to your own site instead, or replace it.
w_link_down: The website may be down for a moment. Run the check again in a few hours before removing the link.
w_link_loop: The website sends you from one address to another and never shows a page. Open the link to see where it leads.
g_link_blocked_one: {count} link could not be checked: the website refuses automatic visits.
g_link_blocked_other: {count} links could not be checked: their websites refuse automatic visits.
w_link_blocked: This often happens with social networks and shops. Open the link yourself to be sure.
w_link_moved: It still works thanks to an automatic forward. Using the new address saves your visitors a detour.
g_link_insecure_one: {count} link uses an unsecured address (without the "s" of https).
g_link_insecure_other: {count} links use an unsecured address (without the "s" of https).
w_link_insecure: The website also works in its secure version: put "https://" at the start of the address.
g_link_unverified_one: {count} link could not be checked this time.
g_link_unverified_other: {count} links could not be checked this time.
w_link_unverified: It is not necessarily a problem: run the check again a little later. Each line says why.
d_same: Same text as in the original language
d_down_network: does not answer (address not found or website off)
d_blocked: answers "{code}" and refuses the automatic visit
d_insecure: unsecured address, but the website answers in https
d_paused: the website asked to slow down: not checked again
d_skipped_perhost: already many links to this website: only the first ones are checked
d_refused: internal or unusual address: deliberately not visited
d_unverified: unsecured address and unreachable in https: cannot be checked
hero_never_title: Your site has not been checked yet
hero_never_text: Press "Check now": it takes a few seconds and changes nothing on your site.
hero_running_text: Links to other websites are checked in small groups, one website at a time, so nobody is bothered.
hero_seen: I looked at {pages} pages, {images} images and {links} links.
hero_ok_info: A few remarks for information, nothing urgent, a little further down.
hero_some_title: A few small things to look at
hero_some_text_one: One remark deserves your attention. Nothing serious: deal with it whenever you like.
hero_some_text_other: {count} remarks deserve your attention. Nothing serious: deal with them at your own pace, the most useful first.
progress_help: Press "Carry on checking" to do the next group. You can also leave the page and come back later.
nc_title: What I could not look at
nc_intro: I would rather tell you than stay silent: here is what this module cannot see.
nc_menu: The site's menu (is it empty?): the module is not allowed to read it.
nc_other_pages: Titles and descriptions of pages made by other extensions (home, contact, schedule…): only pages and articles written in the editor can be read.
nc_files: Images and files uploaded to your site: I cannot check that they still exist.
nc_internal: Links to your own pages are only checked against pages and articles written in the editor.
nc_links_off: Links to other websites: checking is turned off in the settings.
nc_one_language: Translations: your site has only one language, so there is nothing to compare.
nc_capped: Only the {max} most recent entries of "{names}" were looked at.
nc_cut: {n} more sections were not looked at (40 at most).
nc_window: This time: links {from} to {to} out of {total}. Run the check again to see the next ones.
ignore_confirm: Stop showing you this remark? You can show them all again at the bottom of the page.
form_more_title: Some links are still to be checked
check_help: This changes nothing on your site. Links to other websites are visited gently, one at a time, and only when you press the button.
nothing_to_do: Nothing to fix for now. Come back after adding pages or links.
ok_partial: {done} links checked out of {total}. Press "Carry on checking" for the rest.
err_busy: A check is already running. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
err_nothing: There is no check to carry on. Start a new one with "Check now".
err_failed: The check stopped before the end. Try again in a moment.
err_gone: This remark no longer exists. Run the check again to get an up-to-date list.
err_ignored_full: Too many remarks are already hidden (200 at most). Show them again before hiding more.
unlisted_one: And {count} more, not listed here: fix these ones, then run the check again.
unlisted_other: And {count} more, not listed here: fix these ones, then run the check again.
